Canonical database parity currently allocates an owned String for each SQLite text cell before serializing that row. The oracle can borrow those cell values for the row's lifetime while preserving the exact canonical bytes and existing error behavior.

The donor branch's ordinary closeout also exposed a V18 test race: the test obtained a point-in-time status snapshot before checking whether the mock HTTP request had started. A later positive request count could select that earlier snapshot with zero pending work. The original failed execution is retained.

## Changes

- Integrate the exact reviewed PR190 oracle implementation and four correctness controls onto current main `09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7`. Borrow text only during row serialization; preserve field/duplicate-column ordering, numeric encoding, escaped-byte budgets, SELECT error order, read-only access, dual scratch spools and existing limits.
- In the V18 loopback test, observe the existing request barrier before obtaining one fresh status snapshot. Keep every pending/semantic/dense/ready assertion, semaphore release, timeout and provider boundary unchanged. The repair does not retry until the pending assertion happens to pass.
- Add the nonauthor canonical review and support, then update the original source registry's five changed fields and four identity pins. The complete domain is 1,096 product inputs / 79 original-BASE differences / 146 unchanged validation inputs. No workflow changes are included.

The source commits are `d2b853b6…` (oracle integration) and `2b6e9ebf…` (V18 synchronization), followed by review `ca10314f…` and bound head **`4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`**, tree `6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c`.

## Validation and evidence

The [independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json) accepts this exact composition. Its author/reviewer roles remain explicit.

The original v15 verifier actually exited 0 on this G, including the original previous-v14 proof, with all 1,435 selected inputs and actual HEAD/index unchanged. The original task-plan check then passed with all 1,441 required inputs unchanged and confirmed 192 total / 164 done / 28 remaining. Its first attempt failed because six committed plan documents were not materialized in the source-verifier view; that failure is preserved alongside the exact-input recovery and successful original invocation. No source or task status was changed to obtain that result. [Complete admission outputs, original ZIPs, both task-plan attempts and independent binding bridges](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a75a38263c53d5294b0022019be90193ff4e7bbf/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009) are retained.

**New-head Rust and ordinary CI are pending at PR creation.** They must verify this actual composition; the donor's earlier CI is not relabeled as execution of this head. In particular, the V18 repair has a static explanation and still needs its actual post-change execution.

PR190's [independently named finite observation](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004163561) belongs to `f6750cad…`, with all five cases × 20 pairs retained. Its descriptive paired medians are approximately 0.830–0.960 borrowed/original, with all five slower pairs included. [Complete original ZIP/log and independent analysis](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/07308326c3a658bc3f0e8d0cae85f9218bf960fe/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-bfcc-20261009) support only that finite mechanism scope. The older, order-dependent results remain in [PR190](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/pull/190). No current-main, full-indexing or 100k speedup is claimed.

The [original V18 failure and exact proposed repair](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a7791788ee2bf5da26f8b8048c284bff951ead05/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-closeout-failure-bfcc-20261009) remain archived: 11 passed / 1 failed / Cargo101. Its log does not prove the unique runtime interleaving.

## Task and integration boundary

This PR changes zero original TODO statuses. Current main remains **164/192 done, 28 remaining**; only P8-005 has newly completed in the active user task. All original scale-study identities, cohorts, seeds, budgets and deadlines remain unchanged. The ignored cost probes remain available as ignored tests; this PR does not add their triggering workflows.

Reverting this PR restores both source leaves and their prior reviewed-source binding together.

Canonical database parity currently allocates an owned String for each SQLite text cell before serializing that row. The oracle can borrow those cell values for the row's lifetime while preserving the exact canonical bytes and existing error behavior.

The donor branch's ordinary closeout also exposed a V18 test race: the test obtained a point-in-time status snapshot before checking whether the mock HTTP request had started. A later positive request count could select that earlier snapshot with zero pending work. The original failed execution is retained.

## Changes

- Integrate the exact reviewed PR190 oracle implementation and four correctness controls onto current main `09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7`. Borrow text only during row serialization; preserve field/duplicate-column ordering, numeric encoding, escaped-byte budgets, SELECT error order, read-only access, dual scratch spools and existing limits.
- In the V18 loopback test, observe the existing request barrier before obtaining one fresh status snapshot. Keep every pending/semantic/dense/ready assertion, semaphore release, timeout and provider boundary unchanged. The repair does not retry until the pending assertion happens to pass.
- Add the nonauthor canonical review and support, then update the original source registry's five changed fields and four identity pins. The complete domain is 1,096 product inputs / 79 original-BASE differences / 146 unchanged validation inputs. No workflow changes are included.

The source commits are `d2b853b6…` (oracle integration) and `2b6e9ebf…` (V18 synchronization), followed by review `ca10314f…` and bound head **`4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`**, tree `6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c`.

## Validation and evidence

The [independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json) accepts this exact composition. Its author/reviewer roles remain explicit.

The original v15 verifier actually exited 0 on this G, including the original previous-v14 proof, with all 1,435 selected inputs and actual HEAD/index unchanged. The original task-plan check then passed with all 1,441 required inputs unchanged and confirmed 192 total / 164 done / 28 remaining. Its first attempt failed because six committed plan documents were not materialized in the source-verifier view; that failure is preserved alongside the exact-input recovery and successful original invocation. No source or task status was changed to obtain that result. [Complete admission outputs, original ZIPs, both task-plan attempts and independent binding bridges](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a75a38263c53d5294b0022019be90193ff4e7bbf/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009) are retained.

**New-head Rust and ordinary CI are pending at PR creation.** They must verify this actual composition; the donor's earlier CI is not relabeled as execution of this head. In particular, the V18 repair has a static explanation and still needs its actual post-change execution.

PR190's [independently named finite observation](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004163561) belongs to `f6750cad…`, with all five cases × 20 pairs retained. Its descriptive paired medians are approximately 0.830–0.960 borrowed/original, with all five slower pairs included. [Complete original ZIP/log and independent analysis](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/07308326c3a658bc3f0e8d0cae85f9218bf960fe/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-bfcc-20261009) support only that finite mechanism scope. The older, order-dependent results remain in [PR190](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/pull/190). No current-main, full-indexing or 100k speedup is claimed.

The [original V18 failure and exact proposed repair](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a7791788ee2bf5da26f8b8048c284bff951ead05/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-closeout-failure-bfcc-20261009) remain archived: 11 passed / 1 failed / Cargo101. Its log does not prove the unique runtime interleaving.
